title: Robert Hastings' nasal implant and blood on pillow
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Robert Hastings' nasal implant and blood on pillow, about unspecified at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Robert Hastings, the author of a book called UFOs and Nukes, is himself someone who says he has had encounters with UFOs. According to Michels, Hastings wrote another book, Confessions, where he talks about an implant in his nose and waking up with blood on his pillow. If true, it would mean a researcher of these stories had been taken and marked himself.
